test_basis.backend_boundary: backend-facing expectations remain prototype_only or not_integrated

steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Select the password login tab and record the visible active state.
Select the verification-code login tab and record the visible active state.
Select the QR login tab and record the visible active state.
Repeat the tab sequence quickly and stop on QR login.
test_obligations.expected_result: Each selected login method becomes visibly active, the matching panel text is shown, the last selected method remains visible after repeat switching, and prototype_only/not_integrated boundary text remains visible.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: No real credential submission, auth session, tracking, or login backend call is used; real login is prototype_only and not_integrated.

steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Confirm the renewal prompt is visible before interaction.
Dismiss or collapse the renewal prompt.
Use the restore or equivalent control to bring the prompt back.
Repeat dismiss and restore once.
test_obligations.expected_result: The renewal prompt visibly changes state, can be restored for continued review, repeat operations do not break layout, and prototype_only/not_integrated boundary text remains visible.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: No payment page, billing mutation, renewal API, or account state change occurs; real renewal payment is prototype_only and not_integrated.

steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Locate the client download entry.
Click the download entry once and record the visible feedback.
Click the download entry repeatedly.
Confirm the page remains in the prototype and no file download or external navigation starts.
test_obligations.expected_result: The download entry is recognizable, clicking it displays prototype feedback, repeat clicks keep local feedback stable, and no actual download or external transfer occurs.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: Real client download is prototype_only and not_integrated; repeated clicks must not initiate real file delivery.

steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Locate the support entry on desktop and mobile viewports.
Click the support entry once and record the visible feedback.
Click the support entry repeatedly.
Confirm the feedback does not obscure the login or renewal areas on the mobile viewport.
test_obligations.expected_result: The support entry is visible and recognizable on desktop and mobile, clicking it displays prototype feedback, repeat clicks stay local, and mobile layout remains usable.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: Real support system is prototype_only and not_integrated; no chat, ticket, phone gateway, external support page, or tracking integration is invoked.

steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Confirm announcement or notice content is visible without interaction.
Expand or collapse announcement content if the prototype provides that interaction.
Review the announcement area with desktop and mobile viewports.
Confirm long or expanded announcement content does not cover core entries.
test_obligations.expected_result: Announcement content remains visible or expandable, does not cover login, renewal, download, or support entries, and stays clearly marked as prototype-only content.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: Real announcement backend is prototype_only and not_integrated; no CMS, notification, or backend announcement fetch is required for acceptance.

steps: Open the static prototype entry center at desktop 1440x1000.
Record whether login, renewal, download, support, and announcement entries are all identifiable without overlap.
Resize or reopen at mobile 390x844.
Record whether the same entries remain identifiable and usable.
Scroll only if needed and confirm no content spills horizontally.
test_obligations.expected_result: Desktop and mobile layouts preserve the entry center hierarchy; core text does not overlap, controls are not hidden, and no horizontal overflow blocks review at 390px width.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: Responsive behavior is prototype_only; it does not prove production release, deployment, rollback, monitoring, or browser support beyond this prototype review.

test_obligations.source_ac_ref: AC-LOGIN-SWITCH AC-RENEWAL-PROMPT AC-DOWNLOAD-ENTRY AC-SUPPORT-ENTRY AC-ANNOUNCEMENT-DISPLAY AC-RESPONSIVE
steps: Open the static prototype entry center in a browser.
Switch login mode, dismiss renewal prompt, click download, click support, and expand announcement content.
Refresh the browser page.
Observe the default state after refresh.
Repeat the same interaction sequence once after refresh.
test_obligations.expected_result: After refresh, the prototype returns to a documented safe default state and the same interactions can be performed again without stale, broken, or hidden UI state.
test_obligations.boundary_assertion: Refresh recovery uses local prototype state only; no persisted backend session, payment, download, support, announcement, tracking, auth, release, or rollback state is created.

minimum_evidence: interaction notes for login tab switching
interaction notes for renewal dismiss and restore
interaction notes for download and support repeat clicks
qa_handoff_contract.acceptance_boundary: Mock must not be used to prove acceptance or integration; real_browser evidence is required and all backend-facing behavior remains prototype_only or not_integrated.
qa_handoff_contract.release_boundary: These obligations do not approve real production release, auth, payment, download, support, announcement backend, telemetry, or rollback.
